seasons_dates_in_order.name: seasons_dates_in_order
seasons_dates_in_order.value: "seasons"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "seasons"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "seasons"."starts_on" <= "seasons"."ends_on"

serials_bin_needs_location.name: serials_bin_needs_location
serials_bin_needs_location.value: "serials"."bin_id" IS NULL OR "serials"."location_id" IS NOT NULL

stock_levels_value_sign.name: stock_levels_value_sign
stock_levels_value_sign.value: ("stock_levels"."on_hand" = 0 AND "stock_levels"."total_value" = 0) OR ("stock_levels"."on_hand" <> 0 AND ("stock_levels"."total_value" = 0 OR sign("stock_levels"."total_value") = sign("stock_levels"."on_hand")))

order_events_to_state_of_machine.name: order_events_to_state_of_machine
order_events_to_state_of_machine.value:
CASE "order_events"."machine"
        WHEN 'fulfillment' THEN pg_input_is_valid("order_events"."to_state", 'public.order_fulfillment_state')
        WHEN 'cash' THEN pg_input_is_valid("order_events"."to_state", 'public.order_cash_state')
      END

order_events_from_state_of_machine.name: order_events_from_state_of_machine
order_events_from_state_of_machine.value:
"order_events"."from_state" IS NULL OR CASE "order_events"."machine"
        WHEN 'fulfillment' THEN pg_input_is_valid("order_events"."from_state", 'public.order_fulfillment_state')
        WHEN 'cash' THEN pg_input_is_valid("order_events"."from_state", 'public.order_cash_state')
      END

order_lines_amounts_not_negative.name: order_lines_amounts_not_negative
order_lines_amounts_not_negative.value:
"order_lines"."unit_price" >= 0 AND "order_lines"."discount_amount" >= 0 AND "order_lines"."net_amount" >= 0
        AND "order_lines"."tax_rate" >= 0 AND "order_lines"."tax_amount" >= 0 AND "order_lines"."gross_amount" >= 0
        AND "order_lines"."prepaid_amount" >= 0 AND "order_lines"."credit_applied_amount" >= 0
        AND ("order_lines"."unit_cost" IS NULL OR "order_lines"."unit_cost" >= 0)

orders_gifted_total_zero.name: orders_gifted_total_zero
orders_gifted_total_zero.value: "orders"."type" <> 'gifted' OR ("orders"."total_amount" = 0 AND "orders"."lines_gross_amount" = 0 AND "orders"."shipping_charged_amount" = 0 AND "orders"."gift_reason_code" IS NOT NULL)

orders_amounts_not_negative.name: orders_amounts_not_negative
orders_amounts_not_negative.value:
"orders"."lines_gross_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."shipping_charged_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."shipping_tax_amount" >= 0
        AND "orders"."total_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."prepaid_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."credit_applied_amount" >= 0
        AND "orders"."shipping_prepaid_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."shipping_credit_applied_amount" >= 0
        AND "orders"."cod_expected_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."cod_due_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."cod_collected_amount" >= 0
        AND "orders"."remitted_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."delivered_amount" >= 0
        AND "orders"."returned_credit_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."exchange_consumed_amount" >= 0

stock_receipts_reference_length.name: stock_receipts_reference_length
stock_receipts_reference_length.value: "stock_receipts"."reference" IS NULL OR char_length("stock_receipts"."reference") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

stock_receipts_note_length.name: stock_receipts_note_length
stock_receipts_note_length.value: "stock_receipts"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("stock_receipts"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500
